meta.title: Plugin Template demo
meta.description: Opens WordPress Playground with the last published template zip. Bluwp >= 0.2.1 and < 0.3 must also be installed or the settings screen will not boot. Replace the zip URL when a newer release exists. Source of 0.3.0 uses the top-level menu (admin.php?page=plugin-template), not Settings.
meta.author: howtowp
